incidents.name: Incident on 2014-04-22 17:52:01 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2014-04-22 17:52:01 - We are investigating reports of problems downloading tarballs and zips of repositories on GitHub.com.
  • 2014-04-22 17:54:19 - We have confirmed that downloads of tarballs and zip archives of repositories on GitHub.com are unavailable and are working to fix these downloads.
  • 2014-04-22 18:03:15 - We have confirmed that the problem is affecting raw repository content on GitHub.com and are working to restore service.
  • 2014-04-22 18:18:43 - We are still experiencing intermittent errors accessing raw repository content on GitHub.com and are still working to resolve the problem.
  • 2014-04-22 18:32:11 - Access to raw content and tarball/zip archive downloads of repositories have been restored.

incidents.message:

  • 2014-03-22 03:35:14 - Everything operating normally.

incidents.name: Incident on 2014-03-21 13:13:42 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2014-03-21 13:13:42 - We are currently working to mitigate an incoming DDoS attack. We'll provide additional information as it becomes available.
  • 2014-03-21 13:35:16 - We are continuing to work to mitigate the attack and reduce the number of legitimate users who are flagged as attack traffic.
  • 2014-03-21 13:56:38 - GitHub.com performance has been back to normal for some time. We continue to work to tune our mitigation to make sure that there is as little impact to legitimate traffic as possible.
  • 2014-03-21 14:11:45 - GitHub.com remains stable as we continue to mitigate an ongoing DDoS attack. At this time we're discontinuing status updates, but will resume them if the situation changes.

incidents.name: Incident on 2014-03-11 21:29:45 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2014-03-11 21:29:45 - We are currently investigating connectivity issues to GitHub.com. We will update status once we know more.
  • 2014-03-11 21:39:37 - We continue to investigate connectivity problems to GitHub.com. We'll update when we know more.
  • 2014-03-11 22:02:20 - We have identified the problem and are working to restore service as quickly as we can.
  • 2014-03-11 22:10:58 - The site is recovering but we continue to monitor the situation very closely.
  • 2014-03-11 22:32:03 - We're all working hard to restore service as quickly as possible.
  • 2014-03-11 22:39:19 - The site is once again responsive and we believe we have a handle on the problem. We will continue to monitor things very closely.
  • 2014-03-11 23:13:08 - GitHub.com continues to operate normally, but we are performing some additional maintenance before we return to green status.
  • 2014-03-11 23:22:08 - We're investigating problems connecting to GitHub.com.
  • 2014-03-11 23:34:35 - GitHub.com is once again responsive. We have all hands on deck mitigating an evolving series of DDoS attacks.
  • 2014-03-12 00:04:32 - GitHub.com is operating normally, despite an ongoing DDoS attack. The mitigations we have in place are proving effective in protecting us and we're hopeful that we've got this one resolved.
